entities.summary: The Gakunan Railway Line  is a Japanese railway line that runs between Yoshiwara and Gakunan-Enoo Station, all within the industrial area of Fuji, Shizuoka Prefecture. The line has no official name, and is the only line operated by Gakunan Electric Train Co., Ltd. The company was established on April 1, 2013 as a subsidiary of the former operator Gakunan Railway , itself a subsidiary of Fuji Kyuko.
